test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is a famous music director?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khayyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khayyam is a famous music director.
 
• A cash **reward of Rs. 100000 and a souvenir are included with the Hridaynath award for lifetime achievement.**
 
• The recipient of the 2018 Hridaynath Award for Lifetime Achievement is Mohammed Zahur Khayyam Hashmi.
 
• The prize was created in 2011 by the Hridayesh Art organization to honor the composer and performer Hridaynath Mangeshkar.
 
• He is the son of Deenanath Mangeshkar and the younger brother of Lata Mangeshkar and Asha Bhosle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sameer was a famous lyricist who wrote songs for numerous Bollywood films.
 
• Anjaan was a popular lyricist and screenwriter in the Indian film industry.
 
• Kaifi Azmi was a renowned poet, lyricist, and songwriter in the Indian film industry.
 
• It is essential to note that music directors are responsible for composing and arranging music for films, while lyricists write the words (lyrics) for the songs.
